title: Holdings & Performance
description: Your priced holdings (equities, funds, crypto): what you put in, what they're worth, gain/loss, weight and returns — plus purchase lots and price history for a selected holding.

steps.query: SELECT p.account AS account, p.currency AS currency, ROUND(SUM(CAST(p.amount AS REAL)) * -1, 2) AS amount FROM postings p JOIN accounts a ON a.name = p.account WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(json_extract(a.metadata_json, '$."income-type"'), '')) = 'dividend' AND json_extract(a.metadata_json, '$.dividend_of') IS NULL AND p.transaction_date <= :asOf AND (:currency = '*' OR p.currency = :currency) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM postings h JOIN commodities c ON c.code = h.currency AND c.is_currency = 0 WHERE h.transaction_id = p.transaction_id) GROUP BY p.account, p.currency HAVING amount != 0 ORDER BY p.currency, amount DESC

widgets.title: Invested
widgets.helpText: The cost basis of the holdings you held as of the selected date — what you paid for them. Shows every currency; use the Currency filter to focus.

widgets.title: Current Value
widgets.helpText: Market value of your holdings as of the selected date, per currency.

widgets.title: Unrealized Gain
widgets.helpText: Current market value minus cost basis, as of the selected date. Green if up, red if down. Shown per currency.

widgets.title: Value Over Time
widgets.helpText: Monthly market value against what you put in (cost basis), in the selected currency. Months where a holding had no recorded price fall back to cost.

visualization.emptyText: No holdings to chart in this currency yet.

widgets.title: Holdings
widgets.helpText: Sortable. Gain/loss compares the latest recorded price to cost basis; weight is each holding's share of the portfolio in its own currency. Click a holding's name to drill into its lots and price history below. Holdings with no recorded price fall back to cost basis.

steps.query: WITH held AS (SELECT p.currency AS holding, p.cost_currency AS currency, SUM(CAST(p.amount AS REAL)) AS units, SUM(CAST(p.amount AS REAL) * COALESCE(CAST(p.cost_amount AS REAL), 0)) AS cost_basis FROM postings p JOIN commodities c ON c.code = p.currency AND c.is_currency = 0 WHERE p.transaction_date <= :asOf AND p.cost_currency IS NOT NULL AND (:currency = '*' OR p.cost_currency = :currency) GROUP BY p.currency, p.cost_currency), latest AS (SELECT base_currency, quote_currency, CAST(quote_number AS REAL) AS price FROM prices x WHERE x.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM prices y WHERE y.base_currency = x.base_currency AND y.quote_currency = x.quote_currency AND y.date <= :asOf)), joined AS (SELECT h.holding, COALESCE(c.asset_class, 'unclassified') AS asset_class, h.currency, ROUND(h.units, 4) AS units, ROUND(h.cost_basis / NULLIF(h.units, 0), 2) AS avg_cost, ROUND(h.cost_basis, 2) AS cost_basis, lt.price AS last_price, ROUND(CASE WHEN lt.price IS NOT NULL THEN h.units * lt.price ELSE h.cost_basis END, 2) AS market_value, ROUND(CASE WHEN lt.price IS NOT NULL THEN h.units * lt.price - h.cost_basis ELSE 0 END, 2) AS unrealized, CASE WHEN lt.price IS NOT NULL AND h.cost_basis != 0 THEN (h.units * lt.price - h.cost_basis) / h.cost_basis ELSE 0 END AS unrealized_pct, CASE WHEN lt.price IS NOT NULL THEN h.units * lt.price ELSE h.cost_basis END AS mv_raw FROM held h JOIN commodities c ON c.code = h.holding LEFT JOIN latest lt ON lt.base_currency = h.holding AND lt.quote_currency = h.currency WHERE h.units > 0.0001) SELECT holding, asset_class, currency, units, avg_cost, cost_basis, last_price, market_value, unrealized, unrealized_pct, mv_raw / SUM(mv_raw) OVER (PARTITION BY currency) AS weight FROM joined ORDER BY currency, market_value DESC

visualization.emptyText: No priced holdings yet. Add holdings with cost lots and prices to see them here.

widgets.title: Market Value by Holding
widgets.helpText: Each holding's current market value in the selected currency, largest at top. Click a bar to see that holding's transactions.

steps.query: SELECT holding, value FROM (SELECT h.holding AS holding, ROUND(CASE WHEN lp.price IS NOT NULL THEN h.units * lp.price ELSE h.cost_basis END, 2) AS value FROM (SELECT p.currency AS holding, SUM(CAST(p.amount AS REAL)) AS units, SUM(CAST(p.amount AS REAL) * COALESCE(CAST(p.cost_amount AS REAL), 0)) AS cost_basis FROM postings p JOIN commodities c ON c.code = p.currency AND c.is_currency = 0 WHERE p.transaction_date <= :asOf AND p.cost_currency = :currency GROUP BY p.currency) h LEFT JOIN (SELECT base_currency, CAST(quote_number AS REAL) AS price FROM prices x WHERE x.quote_currency = :currency AND x.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM prices y WHERE y.base_currency = x.base_currency AND y.quote_currency = :currency AND y.date <= :asOf)) lp ON lp.base_currency = h.holding WHERE h.units > 0.0001) WHERE value > 0 ORDER BY value ASC

visualization.emptyText: No priced holdings in this currency yet.

widgets.title: Unattributed Dividends
widgets.helpText: Dividend income not tied to a specific holding, per currency. This happens when a cash dividend is paid to a cash account and its income account declares no dividend_of link to the security it came from. It still counts in your income totals, but it can't be assigned to an asset class — so the asset-class returns above leave it out (their XIRR is slightly understated). See the list beside this for which accounts, and add dividend_of: "<SYMBOL>" to attribute them. When everything is attributed, this shows nothing.

widgets.title: Unattributed Dividends by Account
widgets.helpText: The dividend income that makes up the Unattributed Dividends figure, grouped by the income account that recorded it. Click an account to see its transactions; add dividend_of: "<SYMBOL>" to that account's open to attribute its dividends to the security's asset class. This list is empty when everything is attributed.

visualization.emptyText: All dividends are attributed to a holding.

widgets.title: Returns by Asset Class
widgets.helpText: XIRR is your money-weighted annual return — it accounts for when you invested. Simple gain ignores timing. Both are shown per asset class, per currency.

visualization.emptyText: No priced holdings to measure returns on yet.

widgets.title: Purchase Lots — {{params.holding}}
widgets.helpText: The remaining lots of the holding selected in the table above — when each was acquired, how many units, and at what cost.

steps.query: SELECT acquisition_date, ROUND(CAST(units_number AS REAL), 4) AS units, CAST(cost_number AS REAL) AS cost, ROUND(CAST(book_value AS REAL), 2) AS book_value, cost_currency AS currency FROM lots WHERE units_currency = :holding AND acquisition_date <= :asOf ORDER BY acquisition_date

visualization.emptyText: Pick a holding above to see its purchase lots.

widgets.title: Price History — {{params.holding}}
widgets.helpText: Recorded prices for the holding selected in the table above, over time, in the currency it's held in.

steps.query: SELECT date, CAST(quote_number AS REAL) AS price FROM prices WHERE base_currency = :holding AND quote_currency IN (SELECT DISTINCT cost_currency FROM lots WHERE units_currency = :holding) AND date <= :asOf ORDER BY date

visualization.emptyText: Pick a holding above to see its price history.
